formatted_text: To allow **minibuses** to take up and drop passengers off. Such a vehicle must display an appropriate **emblem, logo or any other indication** that they are minibuses.
To reserve a road, lane or parking area for **buses and minibuses only**.
To indicate that a traffic lane is reserved for **buses and minibuses only**.
To indicate **where the reserved lane** for buses and minibuses **begins**.
To reserve a road, lane or parking area for **buses and midi buses only**.
To indicate that a traffic lane is reserved for **buses and midi buses only**.
To indicate **where the reserved lane** for buses and midi buses **begins**.
To reserve a road, lane or parking area for **buses, midi buses and minibuses only**.
To indicate that a traffic lane is reserved for **buses, midi buses and minibuses only**.
To indicate **where the reserved lane** for buses, midi buses and minibuses **begins**.
To indicate that a **freeway begins** at the sign and that the **rules that apply to freeways** are effective from here.
To indicate that a **single-carriageway freeway begins** at the sign and that **all rules that apply to freeways** are effective from here.

To prohibit the entry of **all vehicles with a mass exceeding 3 500 kg**, or vehicles, which have **more than 10 seats**, except for **local access or delivery**. To **yield right of way** to pedestrians in the street. To prohibit vehicles from driving through the area **without breaking their journey**. To limit the speed of vehicles in the area to **30km/h**.
To indicate that the regulatory sign applies **only for the period(s) or during conditions indicated** on this sign.
To limit the **times and periods of stopping**.
To inform you that the regulatory sign applies when **visibility is reduced**.
To inform you that the regulatory sign applies **during daytime**.
To inform you that the regulatory sign **only applies during night time**.
To indicate that the restriction indicated on the regulatory sign applies **in the direction of the arrow**.
To indicate that **parking fees must be paid** in the parking area.
To indicate that the sign applies to drivers of vehicles operated by the **company, owner or organisation** indicated by the **logo or words**.
To indicate to the driver that the reservation indicated on the regulatory sign is **further restricted by a maximum number of vehicles** as indicated on this sign.
To **cancel a restriction**.
To warn that a hazard in the form of a **crossroad is ahead**.
To warn that you are approaching an intersection where you have **right of way**. (The **thicker leg** of the cross on the signs indicates which road has priority.)
To warn that you are approaching an intersection where you have to **yield to cross-traffic**. (The **thicker leg** of the cross on the sign indicates which road has priority.)
To warn that you are approaching an intersection where you have to **turn sharp to the right or left**.
To warn that you are approaching an intersection where **another road meet yours at an angle**.
To warn that traffic may be approaching you from the **left or right-hand side**.

To warn that your road is first joined by another road from the **left hand side first** and within a short distance by another from the **right hand side** (W110,TW110) or from the **right first** and then from the **left** (W109,TW109).

To warn that traffic could **merge from the left** (W112, TW112) or from the **right** (W114, TW114) at sharp angles / To warn that the road you are travelling on will **soon split in two** and you will have to make a choice which road to take.
To warn that the road **forks into two roads**.
To warn that the **one-way roadway is ending soon** and that approaching vehicles will use the **same carriageway as you**.
To warn that the **single carriageway is ending** and that you will soon enter a **one-way road**.
To warn that there is a **traffic circle ahead** where you may need to **yield to other traffic**.
To warn that there is a **gentle curve ahead** to the left or right.
To warn that there is a **sharp curve ahead** to the left or right.
To warn that there is a **very sharp, U-shaped curve ahead** to the left or right.
To warn of a **series of curves ahead**. In the case of W209 the **first curve is to the left** and in the case of W208 the **first bend is to the right**.
To warn that there are **two sharp curves ahead in opposite directions**. W210 indicates the **first curve is to the right** and W211 that the **first curve is to the left**.
To warn that the **one-way roadway you are travelling on will soon become a two-way roadway**.
To warn that **one-way street** you are driving on will **soon be crossed by a street that carries two-way traffic**.
To warn that the **double-lane road** you are driving on **narrows by a full lane** from the **left** (W215 or TW215) or from the **right-hand side** (W214 or TW 214).
To warn that **one or more concealed driveways** enter the road you are driving on from the left or right in such a way that you **cannot easily see the road or traffic travelling on that road**.
To warn that there are **isolated and particularly new traffic lights** or traffic lights near an isolated traffic light at a **pedestrian crossing ahead**.
To warn that there is a **stop sign ahead, which cannot be seen in time**.
To warn that there is a **yield sign ahead**, which you may **not be able to see in time without a warning**.
Indicate that there is a **traffic officer ahead controlling the traffic**.
Indicate that there is a **scholar patrol operating ahead**.
To warn that there is a **demarcated pedestrian crossing ahead**.
